data.standardized_narrative: Opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2017 were GBP 512.3m. During 2017 there was a gross prior-year strengthening of GBP 8.7m (1.7% of opening reserves), primarily reflecting adverse claims development and recalibration of IBNR particularly in the liability sections of the Specialty Programmes and Package Programmes. These reserve movements were small relative to the overall reserve base. The 2017 calendar year was also materially impacted by several named catastrophe events (Harvey, Irma, Maria, Mexico earthquakes and California wildfires) which are treated as current year losses.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development taken from Note 12 movement table row 'Movement arising from prior years' (gross = GBP 8,718k). Opening gross claims outstanding taken from insurance liabilities (gross claims liabilities 512,293 at 31 Dec 2016). No explicit prose sentence describing the prior-year movement was provided beyond the movement table row; exact_reserve_text quotes the table row. Gross premium mix taken from Managing Agent's summary table (calendar year column) because a regulatory segmental note with identical breakdown was not present for the calendar year notes. Claims development triangle is present (gross) in the reserves note; RITC and other adjustments are present elsewhere and may distort simple triangle-based PYD computations but the movement row used here is explicit.
